mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, b.name AS box_name, z.name AS zone_name, z.id AS zone_id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN boxes b ON c.box_id = b.id LEFT JOIN zones z ON b.zone_id = z.id
mapper.select: WHERE c.active = 1 AND c.id NOT IN ( SELECT customer_id FROM bills WHERE issuance_id = #{issuanceId} AND is_trial = 0 ) ORDER BY z.name, b.name, c.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customers (name, phone, address, box_id, billing_type, amper_capacity, meter_number, active) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{boxId}, #{billingType}, #{amperCapacity}, #{meterNumber}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, box_id = #{boxId}, billing_type = #{billingType}, amper_capacity = #{amperCapacity}, meter_number = #{meterNumber}, active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
